input: Unfair discrimination and misrepresentation is a risk associated with An automated system is designed to analyze and match license plate information to identify potential mismatches or anomalies. The system aims to provide accurate and efficient processing of license plate data, helping to facilitate investigations and support law enforcement efforts. It uses advanced algorithms to compare and verify license plate information from various sources.
